name: normalize_naturality
statement: B} (p : Path a b) {f g : Hom b c} (η : f ⟶ g) : (preinclusion B).map ⟨p⟩ ◁ η ≫ (normalizeIso p g).hom = (normalizeIso p f).hom ≫ (preinclusion B).map₂ (eqToHom (Discrete.ext (normalizeAux_congr p η)))
